name: body_impact
description: A body hit: a dull fleshy WHUMP for someone getting punted — a cloth slap tick on contact, a band-passed flesh thump just after, and a deep chest slam under it (brown noise low-passed at 110 Hz + a 95-45 Hz dropping sine, ~0.47 s), through a punchy finish bus. Knobs: heft (weight), flesh (mid band).
prompt: a sound for body impact when you get hit by a car and ragdoll; doomy: too weak/shallow — deepened sub, longer tail, heavier gains Nov 21

name: car_horn
description: A cab horn: a sour dual-tone electric HONK (saw tones ~415/495 Hz, seeded ±25 Hz per-take offset so takes read as different cabs), a brass blat burst and pitch scoop on the attack, grit through tanh drive, a horn-flare resonance, hard stop. Knobs: length (hold), edge (drive + top end).
prompt: new car horn sounds for the friendSLOP NYC cab traffic; doomy: too synthetic — brass blat burst + pitch scoop + saw tones added Nov 21

name: mj_hee_hee
